primary_hostname.description: Canonical hostname announced in SMTP EHLO/HELO and used as the local mail domain. Must resolve in DNS.

message_size_limit.description: Maximum accepted message size. Plain bytes or suffixed value: K, M, G. Use 0 for unlimited.

max_rcpt.description: Maximum number of RCPT TO: recipients allowed per message. Protects against address-explosion attacks.

daemon_smtp_ports.description: TCP ports the daemon listens on. Typical values: 25 (MX inbound), 587 (client submission).

local_interfaces.description: IP addresses to bind. Empty list binds all available interfaces. Example: ["192.0.2.1", "::"].

qualify_domain.description: Domain appended to unqualified sender addresses (e.g. 'root' becomes 'root@qualify_domain'). Usually the organisation's primary domain.

qualify_recipient.description: Domain appended to unqualified recipient addresses submitted by local processes.

local_domains.description: Additional domains accepted for final local delivery. The primary hostname and 'localhost' are always included automatically.

relay_to_domains.description: Domains this server will relay outbound mail to without local delivery. Used for partner or sub-domains. Empty disables relay by domain.

relay_from_hosts.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges trusted to relay without SMTP AUTH. localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 are always implicitly allowed.

ignore_bounce_errors_after.description: Stop retrying undeliverable bounce messages after this period (e.g. 2d, 12h). Prevents infinite bounce loops.

timeout_frozen_after.description: Permanently delete messages that have been frozen (stuck) in the queue after this period (e.g. 7d, 48h).

freeze_tell.description: Email address notified when a message is frozen. Leave empty to disable freeze notifications.

log_selector.description: Space-separated log event flags. Prefix + to enable a class or - to suppress it relative to Exim defaults.

tls_enabled.description: Enable STARTTLS support for incoming connections. Requires valid tls_certificate and tls_privatekey.

tls_certificate.description: Filesystem path to the PEM-encoded server certificate. May include intermediate chain. Used only when tls_enabled is true.

tls_privatekey.description: Filesystem path to the PEM-encoded private key. Must be readable by the Exim user only (mode 0640). Used only when tls_enabled is true.

smarthost.description: Hostname of the relay (smarthost) for all outbound non-local mail (e.g. smtp.sendgrid.net). Leave empty for direct DNS-based delivery.

smarthost_auth.description: Authenticate to the smarthost with SMTP AUTH. Requires smarthost_user and smarthost_password.

smarthost_user.description: SMTP AUTH username presented to the smarthost. Used only when smarthost_auth is true.

smarthost_password.description: SMTP AUTH password for the smarthost. Will appear in plaintext in the rendered config; restrict file permissions accordingly.

rewrite_rules.description: Ordered list of address rewrite rules applied to sender/recipient addresses before routing decisions.

description.description: Human-readable label rendered as a comment above the rule.

replacement.description: Replacement address expression using Exim string expansions (e.g. '${local_part}@example.com').

flags.description: Which address classes to rewrite: F=envelope-from, T=envelope-to, b=Bcc, c=Cc, r=Reply-To, s=Sender header. Combine freely (e.g. 'FT').
